transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Morning, Grace. How's the left shoulder?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Worse this week. Pain is 6 out of 10 at night, up from 4.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I carried grocery bags with my left hand and something pulled. My sleep is broken, too.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Any numbness or tingling in the fingers? Fever?

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Forward reach is 120 degrees, down from 135 at the last visit.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: External rotation strength is 4/5 on the left, same as before.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I've been doing wall slides every day, and band rows three times this week.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Good. This looks like the load from the bags flared things up. It's a setback, not a stop.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Plan: drop the band rows for two weeks, keep the wall slides, and avoid carrying heavy bags with that arm.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay. I want to get back to swimming this summer.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: That goal is reasonable. We'll track it.

expectedFacts.statement: Pain 6 out of 10 at night, up from 4
Drop band rows for two weeks
